name: D. P. Abhushan Limited
summary: D. P. Abhushan Limited engages in the manufacturing, sale, and trading of gold, diamond, platinum, silver jewellery, and other precious metals in India. It also offers solitaire jewellery products; and corporate gifting products, such as gold coins, silver coins and notes, electroform idols, and gift vouchers. The company sells ornaments through its retail showrooms. The company was founded in 1940 and is based in Ratlam, India.
